channel.title: Ovhcloud incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Ovhcloud's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: PCI host outage in US-WEST-OR-1 [investigating]
item.description:
We are aware of an issue affecting a PCI host in this region. Some PCI instances may be unavailable or unresponsive during this time.
Our teams are actively working toward a resolution, and updates will be shared as progress is made. We apologize for the inconvenience.

item.title: Delays in Server Delivery due to Backend Processing Issue [investigating]
item.description:
We're currently investigating an issue where Delivery operations are stuck in "Doing". As a result, orders placed may be significantly delayed while we work on this resolution.
Our teams are actively working toward a resolution, and updates will be shared as progress is made. We apologize for the inconvenience.

item.title: Service Cancelation issue for VPS Product [investigating]
item.description:
Cancellation reversal is currently not working as intended. If the VPS is set to cancel and a request is made to cancel the service cancellation, it remains flagged for removal.
If you are attempting to remove services for VPS, please reach out to our support team by opening a ticket.

item.title: Maintenance to perform vCSA Minor Upgrade to 8.0U3k [maintenance]
[VIN1] Server Power Loss VIN0120A02B [investigating]
item.description: OVHcloud support staff is currently monitoring a rack fault in 120A02B. Power to the rack was temporarily disrupted and has been restored . All servers on the rack are currently backup. If you are experiencing any issues please reach out to OVHcloud support staff.

item.title: One VPS host down in VIN [investigating]
item.description: The down VPS host has been brought back up, and all instances are running normally.
